Ticket 2433: added tests/test_carrier_loyalty_whole.py. A 5 % Deutsche Bahn loyalty lowers the effective cost of an 80 EUR ICE fare by 4.00 EUR on the trip page, the compare view and the share page. The trips list ranks by the raw fare price (app/trips.py best_price), so its Best line ignores loyalty: a follow-up ticket should decide whether it shows the effective cost. Next: the queue.
